brief_data.deck: Anduril, the Costa Mesa defence-technology company that already sponsors NASCAR and Hendrick Motorsports, announced a $5B Series H at a $61B valuation on 13 May 2026, doubling its price in a year, weeks before its first NASCAR title race and the start of production at its $1B Ohio factory.

risks.label: BRAND SAFETY
risks.detail: A weapons maker on a Formula 1 car will draw scrutiny from teams, promoters and a European fan base NASCAR did not test.
risks.counter: Lead with the Boeing-at-Alpine precedent and Cadillac's American identity; agree product-imagery rules up front.

risks.label: CATEGORY DEFINITION
risks.detail: TWG AI is Cadillac's exclusive AI partner and Anduril's Lattice is AI software; the lane must be defence technology, not AI.
risks.counter: Define the lane as defence and autonomous systems and clear it with TWG before the first call.

extended.ask: A 25-minute call with Jeff Miller before the United States GP to test the F1 step-up against the NASCAR programme, confirm the category definition with TWG AI, and size an Official Defence Technology Partner entry against Cadillac's 2027 roster.

value.text: TWG AI holds Cadillac's exclusive AI lane, so the brief does not claim a Lattice-on-the-pit-wall workstream. What Anduril brings is a brand that recruits engineers: co-produced content across Arsenal-1 and the Indiana headquarters, engineering-talent programmes with the team, and a manufacturing story that runs from a hyperscale factory to a race car built in the same country.
value.label: Halo with concrete mechanics (Mode B)

value.text: Anduril's guest list is Pentagon, Congressional, allied-government and prime-contractor audiences, plus the venture and public-market investors who priced the $61B round. Hospitality at Miami, Austin and Las Vegas puts that audience in Cadillac's suite alongside its other B2B partners.
value.label: Commercial lift for the team

value.text: The Hendrick agreement carries warfighter and military-family programmes; the same mechanics translate to the US rounds, with GM Defense as a natural co-sponsor. Content from the Coronado event gives the team a template rather than a blank page.
value.label: Programmes that already exist

value.text: Official Defence Technology Partner designation, engine-cover or rear-wing placement, US-round hospitality, driver and engineering access for recruitment content, and a joint GM Defense and Cadillac engineering story for Anduril's channels.
value.label: What the team gives back

why_now.text: On 13 May 2026 Anduril announced a $5B Series H led by Thrive Capital and Andreessen Horowitz at a $61B valuation, double the $30.5B set by the $2.5B round of June 2025; total funding is now more than $11B over eight rounds. The company announced the round itself and Bloomberg, TechCrunch and GovConWire carried it the same day. Revenue is not disclosed and the brief uses no revenue figure.
why_now.label: Trigger

why_now.text: The US Army awarded Anduril a ten-year enterprise contract with a $20B ceiling on 13 March 2026, consolidating more than 120 procurement actions into one framework built around the Lattice software. The ceiling is a maximum, not an obligated amount, and the brief says so. Arsenal-1, the $1B hyperscale factory in Columbus, Ohio, targets production from July 2026.
why_now.label: The demand behind the price

why_now.text: Anduril is Official Defense Partner of NASCAR and presenting sponsor of the NASCAR San Diego weekend; the Anduril 250 'Race the Base' Cup Series street race ran at Naval Base Coronado on 21 June 2026. It is also a primary sponsor of Hendrick Motorsports' William Byron for two Cup races a season from 2026 through 2028. The question for Anduril is not whether to buy motorsport but whether to scale it to a global engineering audience.
why_now.label: Motorsport is already in the budget

why_now.text: The Miami GP has just run; the United States GP in Austin (October) and the Las Vegas GP (November) are the US rounds left in 2026, and teams close their 2027 partner rosters in the fourth quarter. A listing is expected by analysts in 2027 or later; a partnership agreed over the summer can be announced at Austin and run through the listing window.
why_now.label: Calendar window

why_team.text: GM Defense, a General Motors subsidiary, signed a teaming agreement with Anduril in October 2023 on autonomy, battery electrification and new propulsion, and the two showed Infantry Squad Vehicles fitted with Anduril systems at AUSA that year. Cadillac F1 Team is General Motors' works entry. The introduction can run through a relationship both sides already value.
why_team.label: The warm path

why_team.text: Cadillac's debut roster is deliberately small: TWG AI as primary and exclusive AI partner, Core Scientific for data-centre infrastructure, IFS for enterprise software, Tenneco as technical partner, Jim Beam, Tommy Hilfiger and Claro. No aerospace, defence or autonomy partner is on it, and the team has said it is not seeking a title sponsor in year one, so a top-tier team partner is the largest seat on offer.
why_team.label: The open lane

why_team.text: A Costa Mesa company that used a naval base for its first NASCAR event gets an American works team, an Indiana headquarters, and Miami, Austin and Las Vegas as home rounds. The 'rebuild the arsenal' story and Cadillac's American-engineering debut are the same story told twice.
why_team.label: American identity, US stages

why_team.text: A first-season team prices its partner tier below the established grid, and its inventory is not yet crowded. For a brand that spends on two Cup races a season with Hendrick, the step up to a three-year F1 seat is proportionate to a $5B raise.
why_team.label: Price of entry

ruled_out.reason: Boeing, an aerospace and defence prime, is a team partner; a direct category clash.
Zoox occupies the autonomous-systems lane; Claude's Anthropic tie adds a second software overlap.
Aramco is title partner; a US defence prime beside a Saudi state energy title is a governance question for both sides.
Open and American-owned, but Toyota-titled and without the GM Defense relationship that gives Cadillac a warm path.

ruled_out.team: Oracle Red Bull Racing · Visa Cash App Racing Bulls
ruled_out.reason: Open in the lane, but Austrian-owned with no US identity; Siemens, Hexagon and Ansys hold the engineering-software lanes at Red Bull.

ruled_out.team: Mercedes-AMG Petronas · McLaren Mastercard · Scuderia Ferrari HP · Audi Revolut
ruled_out.reason: Open in the lane but European heritage teams with no US identity; not chosen.

brief_data.bottom_line: A $5B round at $61B, a $20B Army contract ceiling, a factory starting in July and a NASCAR programme already running put Anduril at peak brand-investment authority with a proven appetite for motorsport. GM Defense gives a warm path into Cadillac, the defence lane on the grid is open and two US races remain inside the window.

brief_data.the_case_p1: On 13 May 2026 Anduril announced a $5B Series H led by Thrive Capital and Andreessen Horowitz at a $61B valuation, double the $30.5B set in June 2025, taking total funding past $11B over eight rounds. The demand behind it is public: the US Army awarded a ten-year enterprise contract with a $20B ceiling on 13 March 2026, and Arsenal-1, a $1B factory in Columbus, Ohio, targets production from July. Anduril has bought motorsport already: Official Defense Partner of NASCAR, title sponsor of June's San Diego weekend at Naval Base Coronado, and Hendrick's William Byron through 2028.
brief_data.the_case_p2: That NASCAR programme is the tell. A company that put a Cup Series event on a naval base to recruit engineers and tell a rebuild-the-arsenal story has a template Formula 1 can scale: three US rounds, a global engineering audience and a listing expected in 2027. General Motors is the bridge. GM Defense signed a teaming agreement with Anduril in October 2023 on autonomy and electrification, and Cadillac is GM's works team.

brief_data.value_content: MODE B - halo with concrete mechanics. TWG AI holds Cadillac's exclusive AI lane, so this is not a software workstream. It is: livery and garage presence at Miami, Austin and Las Vegas; engineering-recruitment content, the job Anduril's marketing chief says marketing does, filmed at Arsenal-1 and the team's Indiana headquarters; warfighter-family programmes carried over from the Hendrick deal; hospitality for Pentagon, Congressional and allied guests at the US rounds.
brief_data.why_team_para: Cadillac is General Motors' American works entry, in its first season with a deliberately small roster: TWG AI, Core Scientific, IFS, Tenneco, Jim Beam, Tommy Hilfiger, Claro. No aerospace, defence or autonomy partner is on it, and the parent already works with Anduril through GM Defense, so the introduction is warm on both sides. Three US rounds give a Costa Mesa brand home stages, and a debut team prices entry below the established grid.
brief_data.deal_arch_para: Entry as Official Defence Technology Partner. <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>THREE YEARS</font>, 2027-2029, bridging the Hendrick term and a probable listing. Estimated $8-12M a year, the top of Cadillac's partner tier. Scope: engine-cover or rear-wing placement, US-round hospitality, recruitment and manufacturing content, a joint GM Defense and Cadillac engineering story.
brief_data.why_now_callout: <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9'>WHY NOW</font>  The round closed on 13 May; the NASCAR debut at Coronado is in June and Arsenal-1 starts production in July, so budget, motorsport template and manufacturing story crest together. The United States GP in Austin (October) and the Las Vegas GP (November) fall inside the window; 2027 rosters close in the fourth quarter.
brief_data.decision_maker_bio: Anduril's first marketing chief, hired in May 2024 from Cruise, where he was VP of marketing, after Snapchat, PepsiCo and Ogilvy; he built the NASCAR and Hendrick programmes. Path: Matthew Steckman, President and Chief Business Officer; Matt Grimm, Co-Founder and COO; Brian Schimpf, CEO.
brief_data.opening_angle_quote: “Jeff, you put a Cup Series event on a naval base. Formula 1 gives you Austin, Las Vegas and Miami, a global engineering audience, and GM's own works team, whose parent already works with you. 25 minutes before Austin to size the Cadillac lane?”
